description:
Together is a minimal companion app for to-dos, reminders, and anniversaries.

Solo, it stays clean and out of your way. Paired, it becomes your shared private space.

[MINIMAL & FLUID - NATIVE iOS 26]
Built fully with iOS 26 Liquid Glass and Dynamic Type
Gestures, animations, and sounds tuned to system defaults
Dark mode / Accessibility / Localized in English & Chinese
No ads. No tracking. Collect only what you choose.

[TO-DO LISTS]
Tasks, lists, tags, priorities - surfaced when needed
Repeating tasks: daily / weekly / monthly / lunar holidays
Due dates with multi-level reminders
Drag-to-reorder, swipe-to-complete, smart search

[ANNIVERSARIES & REMINDERS]
Never forget the dates that matter
Smart pre-alerts: Mother's Day, partner's birthday, etc.
Lunar calendar support for traditional dates
Countdown and elapsed-day dual views

[PAIR MODE - OPTIONAL]
Pair with your partner, friend, or family for a shared space
Shared tasks and anniversaries sync instantly
See who added, who did, who hasn't yet - at a glance
Fully usable solo; pairing just adds another layer

[TOGETHER PRO]
Free version is fully usable. Pro unlocks:
Unlimited anniversaries & repeating tasks
Custom themes & app icons
Priority support

[PRIVACY FIRST]
Data lives in your iCloud private database, owned by you
Sign in with Apple - no other account required
Privacy policy and terms in the in-app Profile

For yourself, and the one you share with.

Subscription details, privacy policy, and terms in the in-app Profile.
promotionalText: Minimal companion app for to-dos & anniversaries. Native iOS 26. Fluid, ad-free, no tracking. Great solo, even better paired.
